description: Fixed-rate, fully amortising mortgage: equal monthly payment of principal and interest. Returns the monthly P&I, the lifetime interest, the total paid, and what share of the first payment is interest. Optionally adds monthly property tax, insurance and HOA to the total. Use this instead of estimating: the payment is exact to the cent and matches the calculator on figuredeck.com.

annual_rate_percent.description: Nominal annual interest rate in percent, e.g. 6.5 for 6.5%.

loan_amount.description: Amount borrowed in dollars — the price minus the down payment, not the price.

monthly_hoa.description: Optional monthly HOA or condo dues in dollars.

monthly_insurance.description: Optional monthly homeowners insurance in dollars.

monthly_tax.description: Optional monthly property tax in dollars.

name: mortgage_payment
title: Monthly mortgage payment, total interest, total paid
